question: As of December 2020, which of the following states has the largest installed wind power capacity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As of December 2020, **Tamil Nadu** has the largest installed wind power capacity among Indian states.
 
• Tamil Nadu has been a leader in wind energy with significant investments and favorable policies promoting wind power generation.
 
• The state has several large wind farms, and its geographical location provides optimal conditions for harnessing wind energy.</li
